$schema-note: Live exceptions to the dependency-currency release gate (check 11, scripts/dependency-currency.mjs). Every entry must carry package, tree, heldAt, reason, addedAt and reviewBy. A hold whose reviewBy has passed fails the gate; so does a hold for a package that is no longer outdated, and so does a hold with an empty reason. Holds apply ONLY to the outdated half of the check — a known vulnerability at moderate severity or above is never holdable.

holds.reason: Pinned as an ABI-matched pair with tree-sitter-wasms 0.1.13. Verified 2026-07-27 against web-tree-sitter 0.26.11: every prebuilt grammar in 0.1.13 fails to instantiate (empty Error from Language.load) because those grammars target the older grammar ABI, and 0.1.13 is the newest grammar bundle published. Upgrading the runtime alone therefore silently drops all six long-tail language grammars (rust, solidity, go, swift, cpp, c) with no error surfaced to the user. There is no matched pair to upgrade to; revisit when a grammar bundle built for the newer ABI is published. See scanner/src/ir/tree-sitter-loader.js.

@types/vscode is not an ordinary dependency: it declares the VS Code API SURFACE the extension compiles against, and VS Code's own guidance is that it tracks `engines.vscode` — the OLDEST host the extension supports — rather than the newest published types. Upgrading it to latest is actively harmful: it lets the extension compile against APIs that do not exist on the hosts it claims to support, and the failure surfaces as a runtime TypeError in a user's editor rather than a build error here. 'Latest' is therefore the wrong target for this package by construction, which is exactly the case this hold list exists for. RESOLVED 2026-10-31: the types were ahead of the declared minimum host (`engines.vscode: ^1.95.0` against `@types/vscode: ^1.125.0`), which also made `vsce package` refuse to run. They are now pinned EXACTLY at the declared floor, 1.95.0, so the type-check compiles against the oldest host's API and the supported host range is unchanged (no product decision was needed: lowering the types narrows nothing). The pin is exact because a caret range still resolved to 1.125.0 in the lockfile. Raise `engines.vscode` and this pin together, deliberately, when the minimum host moves.
